default_query.query: Why did the comms subsystem fail at 14:32?

facts.statement: Battery bus voltage dropped to 23.8 V at 14:31:42 UTC.
EPS current draw increased by 17% during RF amplifier spool-up.
S-Band transmitter signal strength decreased by 12 dBm at 14:32:18 UTC.

inferences.statement: Power instability in the electrical power subsystem (EPS) is the primary contributor to communication link degradation.
inferences.reasoning: 2 independent telemetry observations confirm simultaneous bus voltage dip and RF amplifier thermal load spike matching historical incident pattern.

recommendations.action: Check battery bus voltage and switch EPS regulator to redundant Bus-B.
Verify communications transmitter current draw and toggle low-power S-Band mode.
Compare telemetry signature and voltage recovery curves with historical incident INC-047.

dropped_claims.claim: Battery bus voltage dropped below catastrophic threshold to 21.5 V.
dropped_claims.reason: Numerical mismatch against evidence record T-19281 which confirms actual value of 23.8 V.
